Drawback: Bodily Toll.description:
🩸 Your Quirk costs your body something specific: nausea, a nosebleed, cramps, a bleeding scalp or torn muscle.

⚠️ The cost grows as you push.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ochaco Uraraka (Zero Gravity), Yuga Aoyama (Navel Laser), Minoru Mineta (Pop Off).
Drawback: Bodily Toll.traitNarrativeEffects: Each use costs the body a symptom fitting the family (nausea for weight and motion Quirks, stomach cramps for beams, nosebleeds for mental Quirks, bleeding skin where material is produced, torn muscle for strength) unless the player names another; once set, it stays the same. Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): the symptom starts (queasiness, a trickle of blood, a hidden cramp). Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; the symptom gets in the way (vomiting, doubling over, blood in the eyes), and any use beyond light risks losing the next turn to it. Quirk Strain 100: a serious injury (internal strain, heavy bleeding or collapse from the symptom); no Quirk use until Strain falls below 60. Signs fade as Strain falls below each threshold; injuries heal as injuries do. Ordinary life: practice around the symptom; tissues, painkillers or ginger candy at hand, regular checkups; hiding how bad it gets. Quirkless: no Quirk, no Strain.
